newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's OLS Group seen in HK$165 mln float - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's OLS Group seen in HK$165 mln float - sources.

text.p: Construction contractor OLS Group Ltd is expected to raise about HK$165 million through an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong later in June, market sources said on Wednesday.
The company is expected to float about 25 to 30 percent of its enlarged share capital with dealing in the company's shares expected to begin near the end of the month, they said.
Sources said no further listing details were immediately available to the market, but they said OLS Group was expected to hold a presentation for analysts on Friday.

OLS Group engages in specialist construction contracting in "alterations and additions" -- the process of restructing, remodelling and refurbishing works done to existing buildings -- and "fit-outs" -- the process of finishing the interior or exterior of buildings, sources close to the listing said.
They said the company's business in Hong Kong contributed 88 percent of its turnover for the year ended in December 1996, while China at 12 percent.

Fit-out projects accounted for 56.4 percent of the company's turnover and 34 percent came from alterations and additions, sources said, adding that outstanding contracts on hands amounted to HK$572.09 million as at May 31, 1997.
